Image Palette Extractor

Extract dominant colors from any image.

Pixels are sampled at ~64px and bucketed into 4-bit color bins; the top 8 bins win.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload an image (PNG or JPG).
  2. The 8 dominant colors are extracted automatically.
  3. Click any swatch to copy its HEX value.
  4. All processing happens locally — nothing is uploaded.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are dominant colors found?

The image is drawn at about 64px, its pixels are bucketed into 4-bit-per-channel color bins, and the 8 bins with the most pixels win. The displayed hex is the average color of each winning bin.

Is it exact?

It is a fast approximation, not a perceptual clustering algorithm — near-identical shades can merge, and tiny but vivid accents may be missed.

How do I copy a color?

Click any swatch to copy its HEX value to the clipboard.
